initialPrompts.name: 01-pencil-street
initialPrompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one high-resolution wide landscape concept illustration for PlanGTA, a GTA development feasibility app. The two attached local images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: preserve their restrained technical drawing sensibility, tiny modular details, subtle hatching, simple readable repeatable building pieces; reimagine the composition into a much richer harmonious master-plan streetscape. Not a screenshot, no app chrome, no financial KPIs, no CAD sheet, no photorealistic architectural marketing render, no plastic LEGO bricks. This is an illustrative synthetic overview assembled from information, not an approved architectural proposal. Build a coherent physically plausible scene with at least EIGHT distinct primary buildings: slender residential tower with balcony stacks on brick retail podium; stepped midrise with planted terraces; courtyard rental block; three-storey townhouses; retained heritage brick commercial row with arches; glass office building; library/community building with sawtooth roof; low industrial/flex building. Make the components feel like a consistent repeatable illustrated kit rather than unique sculptural architecture. Include green roofs, solar panels, screened rooftop equipment, patio and shopfronts, playground pocket park, mature and young trees, benches, street lamps, bins, bike racks, a protected cycle lane, accessible crosswalks, bus shelter and bus, modest subway entrance pavilion and elevator, a regional train/platform further back, parked and moving cars, delivery van, diverse tiny pedestrians including wheelchair user, stroller, cyclists. A creek/river with a footbridge and planted promenade at one edge provides nearby water context. Arrange streets, paths and building entries coherently with breathing space and a hierarchy of detail. Use deliberate line weights, believable ground connections and natural consistent shadows if appropriate. Show one subtle short red dashed zoning-height segment and limited delicate hatching on upper floors of one tower, without dominating the scene. No impossible geometry or stairs to nowhere. No labels except the small unobtrusive words 'Illustrative concept'. All details and locations are imaginary.

01 — Pencil elevation. Preserve the source's frontal streetscape format, but use a shallow oblique depth so side streets, roof gardens and a creek-side public space can be seen. Warm ivory paper, extremely fine graphite linework, slight hand-drawn irregularity visible at close inspection, delicate technical crosshatching, pale blue-grey glass, restrained sage foliage and a few warm brick washes. A broad continuous streetscape with eight varied buildings stepping from low townhouses to towers. Crisp professional drawing at thumbnail size, rewarding pencil texture on zoom. Wide 16:9 composition with generous paper margin, drawing fills most of frame.

refinedBase: Use case: stylized-concept. Wide landscape illustrated STREET STRIP, not a neighbourhood aerial view. This is a visual concept for an automatic, data-driven development-accounting overview. NOT architecture customization, NOT CAD, NOT an architectural design proposal. Reimagine the attached screenshots' simple long horizontal elevation and modularity. MANDATORY COMPOSITION: exactly one straight horizontal ground baseline across the page, flat front elevations with only a very small consistent side-face depth (cabinet projection, about 10 percent of facade width), NO diagonal street, NO diagonal city blocks, NO entire 3D neighbourhood, NO perspective vanishing point. All EIGHT freestanding/project building modules stand side by side and remain visible and equally important; do not put a single hero tower in the middle. Use a calm, open extremely wide paper composition. From left to right: generic residential tower A 50m high, midrise B 25m, generic tower C 40m, townhouse row 10m, pocket park with playground and trees, mixed-use building D 30m with simple retail glazing and green roof, office block E 20m with solar panels, retained heritage lowrise F 12m, community centre G 8m, slender residential block H 35m. Apply one consistent visible height scale to all buildings: 50m is 25% taller than 40m, 10m is one fifth of 50m, buildings stand on the same level. Draw generic repeatable window bays, a few balconies where present; avoid elaborate custom architectural details. Shopfronts, green roof, small mechanical enclosure, rooftop seating, garage door only as simple readable symbols. One straight street ribbon across the foreground with plausible small cars about 1.8m wide and 4.5m long relative to a 50m tower, a bus about 12m long, a bus shelter, a small subway entrance pavilion, lamps, benches, bike racks, crosswalk and diverse small people about 1.7m high. Cars and people must be much smaller than even the townhouse. A very faint muted background strip of context building silhouettes and trees only; at far right a SMALL creek and bridge context vignette, not an entire waterfront running along every building. Far background context is visibly secondary to the assembled project row. Tiny clean letters A through H may identify buildings, no numeric stats or fake financial values. Top margin title 'Illustrative street strip'. Calm legible information illustration made from repeatable vector-friendly modules. Small watercolor/pencil texture is allowed, geometry remains simple.
refinedPrompts: Style 07: warm offwhite paper, extremely fine grey graphite outlines with slight natural pencil texture, very light watercolour washes confined to shapes: sage planting, muted teal glass, warm sandy heritage accent, grey road. Predominantly FLAT 2D ELEVATION with the tiny side depth specified, not an aerial isometric cityscape. Rich enough to reward zoom, simple enough to imagine the modules being assembled in code. Keep the background nearly empty.

Style 08: the exact same single horizontal eight-building street-strip composition and realistic height proportions, this time classic dark Prussian-blue blueprint with clean ivory linework, restrained pale cyan hatching and fills. No photorealistic lighting, no 3D aerial view. Simple repeatable building and object symbols, sparse fine detailing, quiet background. Show a small unobtrusive dashed known-height-limit segment beside one tower, no claim of compliance.
